purpose: Ensure that generated academic work is honest, traceable, and consistent with the student's actual research.
prohibited_behaviour: Inventing research participants or survey responses
Claiming that an experiment was performed when it was not
Claiming that a prototype was tested when it was not
Copying source material without appropriate attribution

research_status.planned: The work is proposed but has not been carried out.
research_status.in_progress: The work is currently being conducted.
research_status.completed: The work has been carried out and its evidence is available.

engineering_project_rules: Distinguish theoretical calculations from measured results.
Show equations, input values, units, and calculation steps when appropriate.
Do not describe a proposed design as a successfully tested system.
Flag contradictory measurements or calculations for investigation.
Identify safety concerns and relevant standards when applicable.
validation_actions: Flag inconsistencies between objectives, methodology, and findings.
Flag unsupported claims of successful testing.
Request missing information rather than inventing it.
